descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
本接口用于添加AINode节点。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制默认为1000次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。

<props="china">本文档中的QPS仅为默认参考值，准确信息请参见[API速率配额列表](https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/flow-control-products/gpdb/quotas)。</props>
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

This operation is used to add an AINode node.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. Exceeding the limit will trigger API rate limiting, which may impact your business. Please call the API responsibly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb add-ai-node --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --ai-node-pool-id aipool-xxxxx --ai-node-spec-infos NodeNum=2 NodeSpec=ADB.AIStandard.1 --region cn-hangzhou
